tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'dod don lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo ratna tra yā ya/ phan bde'i mchog stsol dkon mchog rin chen gsum// mi phyed dad pa'i gtsug gis gus mchod nas// 'gro kun bdud bzhi'i la sogs 'jigs pa las// bskyab phyir brgya bzhi'i cho ga mdor bsdus bkod// de la sbyor ba yo byad 'byor tshad bshams pa/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i rim pa dang*/ rjes lo rgyus kyi sgo nas phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ gang du bya ba'i sa phyogs rnams gtsang zhing dag par byas/ maṇḍal gyi gzhi la dri zhim gyis chag chag gdab/ der thig chen brgyad spyi ltar gdab pa'i lte ba nas zlum skor lngas bskor ba'i dbus mthing ga /zlum skor dang po pad 'dab mdzes tshon/ gnyis pa dkar po/ gsum pa dmar po/ bzhi pa sngon po/ de phyir ston pa'i phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can bris/ phyag gi mkhrig ma'i thad du rin po che'am/ mañdzi'i khri'u la ston pa'i sku byin rlabs can phyag sor la phyogs par bzhugs so// lte bar zangs gzhong sogs su 'bru sna'i ngar zan la yon bdag gi glud khru gang pa skye mched dod cing gos rgyan gyis mtshan pa/ pho la stag pa dang*/ mo la glang ma'i shing byang lo grangs kyi khram btab pa/ rgyab tu 'dod gsol bris pa phrag g.yas la btsug pa/ nam rgyang*/ mda' 'phang sogs kyis brgyan pa'o// 'bru sna rin po che/ gos dar sogs dkor cha du mas bskor nas/ mthe bong ma gtogs phyag sor bzhi'i rtse la 'jim pa sogs 'bur du byas pa'am/ shing byang la bris pa sogs gang yang rung ba'i bdud bzhi'i gzugs bkod/ phung po'i bdud ser po mdzub mo/ 'chi bdag gi bdud nag po gung mo/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud dmar po srin lag /lha'i bu'i bdud dkar po mthe'u chung la bkod/ maṇḍal gyi pad 'dab la phung po'i bdud sel phyir sku gdung satstsha brgya/ mu khyud gnyis pa la lha'i bu'i bdud sel phyir lha bshos brgya/ mu khyud gsum pa la nyon mongs pa'i bdud sel phyir mar me brgya/

mu khyud bzhi pa la 'chi bdag gi bdud sel phyir ngar glud brgya/ de rnams bskor thabs su mdzes par bkod/ gzhung las/ mchod sbyin phyag rgya g.yas pa ru// brgya bzhi'i yas dang rdzas bsags te// phyag sor rtse la mgron bkug nas// bdud bzhi bsal te mdangs dang ldan// zhes gsungs pa ltar rim pa bzhin bkod/ gzhan yang de dag mthar spyi dang bye brag gi gtor mchod dang gser skyems la sogs pa yang bshams/ rang gi mdun nam phyogs gang bder dkon mchog spyi gtor dang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga sogs dang*/ 'thor rgyu'i me tog dang rol mo'i cha byad sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas nas bsham mo// de ltar bshams pa ni rab 'byor pa can gyi bshams tshul yin la/ gzhan la rdzas rnams lnga bcu'am nyer lnga sogs bshams la me long gcig gam/ gsum la sogs gzugs brnyan shar ba'i grangs ni kha bskang bas 'bring gi brgya bzhi ste gzugs brnyan gyi brgya bzhi dang*/ tha ma rdzas re re tsam la brten nas brgya bsngo ba yin no// zhes zer ro// gnyis pa cho ga'i rim pa la/ dpung bskyed pa'i rgyab chos dang*/ cho ga dngos gzhi dang gnyis las/ dang po dge 'dun la chos ston drangs nas/ spyir dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ sher snying bton/ bye brag skabs don dang sbyar te/ tshe bsring ba la tshe mdo/ mi gtsang ba sel ba la rnam 'joms/ phur kha bzlog pa la gtsug tor gdugs dkar nag /rims kha bzlog pa la ma mo'i bstod gzungs dang*/ gtsug tor nag mo/ sa bdag gi gnod pa zhi ba la klu'i spang skong*/ gshin don spang skong phyag rgya pa/ dbang thang gso ba la dzambha la dang nor rgyun gyi gzungs 'don/ gza' skar ngan pa bzlog pa la sdong rgyan dang snang brgyad 'don/ gzhan yang chos skyong la bskang gsol dang*/ sde brgyad 'byung po sogs la gser skyems gtor ma sogs dpung bskyed pa'i cho ga ci 'grub bya/ gnyis pa cho ga dngos gzhi'i rim pa bcu gsum las/

dang po bdag bskyed ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ ser po/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang ba las rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bur zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas sa gnon dang g.yon pa mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can no/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i bdag nyid du bzhugs par gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥs spyan drangs/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag dang*/ arghaṃ nas/ shapda'i bar gyis mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsgoms la/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa ci nus bzlas la/ gnyis pa sku gdung rab gnas ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar gshegs par gyur/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan// tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi dag la// thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// spyan drangs/

arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing bstod/ nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams 'od zer gyi phung por gyur nas sku gdung la thim par gyur/ me tog dor zhing rten 'brel snying po bzlas nas sātstsha la gtor/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mdo yang 'don la shis brjod bya/ gsum pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ rab gnas bya ba'i tshogs rten nyid du mos so/ mchod bstod yan lag bdun pa bya zhing*/ bsdu na bzang spyod nas byung ba yan lag bdun pa tsam bya'o// spyir bdag bskyed ni yi dam gang la byas kyang rung*/ 'dir bstan cho ga ni yig rnying khungs ldan dpyad bzod pa dag las/ bdag bskyed nas tshogs bsags pa ni gong gi bsgrigs rim 'byung ba de ltar ro// bzhi pa rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis ma dag pa'i dngos po thams cad bsreg gtor bkrus te stong par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ bye brag tu sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i thal mo khong stong du snying gar sbyar te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddhonya haṃ/ lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ rdzas rnams rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod ni/ thal mo khong stong du sen mo rtse sprad pas tshigs rnams bcag pa smin mtshams su bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga zad mi shes pas nam mkha' gang bar bsam mo// bdud rtsi thab sbyor ni/ thal mo sbyar ba phyir bskyed/ mthe bong gnyis bsnol te kha'i thad kar bzhag la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yo byad thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/par bsam/ rgya chen shugs ldan gyi sngags dang phyag rgya g.yas rdo rje khu tshur bcing ba'i mdzub mo bsgreng*/ g.yon pa sa gnon byas la/

oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ yo byad thams cad so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par bsams la/ ye shes skar mda' ni/ g.yas rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bca' la/ g.yon mchod sbyin gyis snod 'degs pa'i tshul la/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs manta spha ra na rasmi saṃ bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dzwa la ni hūm̐/ yo byad thams cad mgron rnams 'thab rtsod med par longs spyod par bsam mo// dbang bsgyur 'khor lo ni/ lag gnyis kyis sor mo'i nang du bsnol nas mkhrig mar sbyar/ mthe bong gnyis gshib ste gyen la spyi bor bzhag nas/ na maḥs manta buddha naṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañtsa dza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ mgron rnams thams cad bdag nyid kyi dbang du gyur par bsam la/ de ltar sngags lan gsum mam bdun brjod pas phyag rgya bkrol ba na se gol bya'o/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan gdags slad// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod/ lnga pa mgron rnams spyan drangs pa ni/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do/ kyai/ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso ste bden pa'i mchog /chos nyid chags dang bral te bden pa'i mchog /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso ste bden pa'i mchog /bden pa'i mchog ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'// dkon mchog bka' la mi nyan gang yang med// srid pa'i rtse nas dmyal khams yan chad kyi// mgron gyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad kun// tshur byon bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon/ kyai/ srid gsum 'di na su yang rung*// gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rigs rnams// tshur byon rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon// 'bul ba bdag gis ma nor la// bzhes pa khyod kyis ma 'khrul cig

/'chi bdag bdud dang phung po'i bdud// nyon mongs bdud dang lha'i bu'i bdud// bdud bzhi bdud kyi dmag dpung tshogs// skye mched mu bzhi gnas dag nas// deng gi gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyis// dkon mchog bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// da lta nyid du gshegs su gsol// sngon tshe lha dbang brgya byin ni// 'chi bdag bdud kyis zin pa las// bcom ldan rgyal ba shāka thub kyis// brgya bzhi'i sbyin pa btang ba yis// lha dbang brgya byin bsnyun las thar// da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// bdud bzhi'i khram kha bab pa dang*// lha 'dre'i dal kha zug pa dang*// mo ngan rmi ltas ngan pa dang*// 'byung bzhi'i bdud ni g.yos pa dang*// ngan pa thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir// brgya bzhi'i yas dang rdzas bsags te// 'byung ba'i bdud bzhi spyan 'dren no// skad cig tsam gyis 'dir gshegs la// bcom ldan thub pa chen po yi// phyag sor bzhi yi rtse la bzhugs/ oṃ e hye hi/ zhes spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ rang rang gi gzugs dang gnyis su med par bzhugs par gyur/ drug pa rdzas rnams spyir bsngo ba ni/ kyai/ sngon tshe rgyal ba shāka thub kyis// lha dbang snyun gyis zin pa la// mchog sbyin phyag rgya g.yas pa ru// brgya bzhi'i yas dang rdzas bsags te// phyag sor rtse la mgron bkug nas// bdud bzhi bsal te mdangs dang ldan// sngon gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis// bsam sbyor dang bas bshams pa yi// mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di bzhes la// khram la bab na khram kha bsgyur// shwa la bab na sho rdel gtong*// rtsis la bab na rtsis rdel phyung*// rgyan la bab na rgyan kha los// bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol// bdud kyi zhags pa slar sdus shig /kye/ lha'i bu'i bdud ni dkar po khyod// shes bya'i sgrib pa dag las byung*// nyon mongs bdud ni dmar po ste// dug lnga nyon mongs sgrib las byung*// 'chi bdag bdud ni nag po khyod// bag chags las kyi sgrib las byung*// phung po'i bdud ni ser po khyod// rnam smin las kyi sgrib las byung*// da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi

/sgrib pa rnam bzhi sbyang ba'i phyir// mchod dang sbyin pa'i las bya yis// mchod pa'i zhing ni dkon mchog gsum// sbyin pa'i mgron ni bgegs kyi tshogs// mchod rdzas mar me zhal zas dang*// lan chags glud dang gtor ma yis// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags pa'i// nyon mongs sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib// bag chags sgrib dang rnam smin sgrib// sgrib pa rnam bzhi sbyang ba'i phyir// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'dis// lha bdud shes bya'i sgrib las thar// snang byed gsal ba'i mar me 'dis// nyon mongs dug lnga'i sgrib las thar// lan chags srog glud 'di bsngos pas// 'chi bdag bag chags sgrib las thar// bsod nams tshogs su 'di bsngos pas// phung bdud rnam smin sgrib las thar// bdud bzhi sel ba'i gto dpyad 'dis// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bar chad rkyen rnams bzlog pa'i phyir// glud kyi sga dang yas sgo 'khyil// grib dang mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs// tshogs gnyis bsags pas dag par byed// bdud kyi gtso bo bdud chen bzhi// cho ga snang gsal brgya bzhi ste// mchod sbyin rgya chen rim gro 'dis// bdud chen bzhi po rab tu sel// nad kyi gtso bo 'du ba bzhi// 'byung ba rnam bzhi 'dus pa yis// gzugs kyi phung po 'jigs par byed// de ni tshangs pa sman gyis sel// bgegs kyi gtso bo bdud chen bzhi// bar chad rkyen dang glo bur byed// de dag mchod sbyin brgya bzhi yi// cho gas gnod byed sel bar byed// 'gro ba rab 'bring tha ma'i blos// dngos dang gzugs brnyan ting 'dzin gyis// brgya bzhi byin gyis brlabs nas ni// bdud chen bzhi la 'bul lags na// dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes mdzod la// bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol// phyin chad gnod pa ma byed par// srid zhi'i mgron dang ldan gyur cig

/ces bsngo zhing glud gtor rnams kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis yid tshims par bsngo zhing*// sngags brgya rtsa rdzogs nas phrin las gsol bar bya'o// skabs 'dir gser skyems dang gtor ma bsngo ba yig rnying gi dkyus na mi gsal/ bar skabs kyi lag len du 'dug pas spro na zur du blta'o// bdun pa bye brag tu bsngo ba ni/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyis ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// bdud kyi dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// bdud chen bzhi yi phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// bdud kyi dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti she pri ba sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ ces pas so sor gser skyems mchod/ yon bdag gam gzhan gyis kyang rung ste/ nas nag gi brab pa sogs bya'o/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// gshin rje'i dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// gshin rje rnams kyi phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// gshin rje'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti ya ma rā tsa sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// gnod sbyin dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// gnod sbyin rnams kyi phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// gnod sbyin dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti yakṣa grī wa sarba a pa na ye swā hā/

kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// tshangs pa'i dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// tshangs pa lha yi phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// tshangs pa'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti brahma sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// srin po'i dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// srin po'i dmag dpung phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// srin po'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti raksha sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la// rgyal po'i dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// rgyal po'i dmag tshogs phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// rgyal po'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti rā dza sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// the'u rang dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// the'u rang rnams kyi phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// the'u rang dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti kar sha li sarba a pa na ye swā hā/

kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// gza' skar dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// gza' skar rnams kyi phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// gza' skar dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti rā hu la sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// sa bdag klu gnyan byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// sa bdag klu gnyan phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// sa bdag dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti nā ga rā dza sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la// ma mo'i dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// ma mo rnams kyi phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// ma mo'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti ma ma rakmo sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// mi'i dmag dpung byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// mi yi dmag dpung phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// mi yi dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti na ra sarba a pa na ye swā hā/

kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// me lha'i 'jigs pa byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// me lha rnams kyi phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// me lha'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti raṃ sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// chu lha'i 'jigs pa byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// chu lha rnams kyi phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// chu lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti khaṃ sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la// sa lha'i 'jigs pa byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// sa lha'i rgyal po'i phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// sa lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti lam̐ sarba a pa na ye swā hā/ kyai/ mtho ba rnams ni mar gson cig /dma' ba rnams kyang yar gson cig /che ba rnams kyis ma skyon cig /chung ba rnams kyang ma 'khor cig /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// rlung lha'i 'jigs pa byung ba'i tshe// yon bdag glud du brgya bzhi 'bul// satstsha brgya dang snang gsal brgya// gtor ma brgya dang ngar glud brgya// rlung lha'i dmag tshogs phyag tu 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi glud du 'bul// rlung lha'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol// oṃ a pa ra tsakra hrīḥti yam̐ sarba a pa na ye swā hā/

zhes brjod cing gser skyems 'thor la nas nag gis brab nas rol mo dang bcas pa bya'o// brgyad pa glud bsngo ba ni/ phyag mthil gyi glud chen gtso bor dmigs te/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las yon bdag gi 'dra glud mdzes shing brjid pa yid du 'ong ba/ smra mkhas shing shes rig bkra ba/ 'jam pa'i gos dang mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ mkho rgu'i dkor nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/ rgyas par sngags drug phyag drug gam/ bsdu na nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐/ srid gsum 'di na gang yang rung*// bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa gang*// tshur gshegs rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon// rin chen 'bru mchog ngar gyi mi// nam mkha'i sems la zho sha'i snying*// dung gi rus la bse yi sha// mtshal gyi khrag la me yi drod// rlung gi dbugs la chu yi khams// zer mo'i skra la mu tig klad// lung thang mig la mgron bu'i so// le brgan lce la dbang po'i lag /zangs lcags rkang la dar zab gos// rin chen rgyan cha dkor cha'i nor// phung khams skye mched dag dang ldan// gzugs mdzes gom stabs lams se lam// smra mkhas ngag snyan kyu ru ru// sems ni rtog dpyod hrigs se hrig /bcas bcas de ni brdar brdar nas// skyes pa dmag la chas pa 'dra// brgyan brgyan de ni spungs spungs nas// na chung bag mar chas pa 'dra// btsal btsal de ni bsags bsags nas// rgyal po'i bang mdzod dbye ba 'dra// de 'dra'i glud bzang ngo mtshar can// mi bas glud bzang bzhes su gsol// lan chags bskang zhing bu lon byang*// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa sgyur// dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen rnams sgyur// chags che nyam nga zhi ba dang*// tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// ces dang*/ sngon gyi skyes rabs brjod de 'bul ba ni/ kyai/ sngon tshe rgyal ba shāka thub kyis// mchog sbyin phyag rgya g.yas pa ru// phyag sor rtse la bdud bzhi bos// mgron du bkug nas mchod sbyin bsngos// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po ni// dad can phyag gi mthil du bzhag

/gces par mdzad nas dbang bskur bas// sgrib pa bzhi las gyur pa yi// bdud bzhi bsal te mdangs dang ldan// sngon tshe bden pa'i byin rlabs ltar// da ltar bdag dang yon bdag gi /gzugs glud phyag gi mthil du bzhag /mtha' mar brgya bzhi'i rdzas kyis bskor// bdud bzhi phyag sor rtse la bzhag /byin gyis brlabs shing bsngos te 'bul// bden pa chen po'i bka' la nyon// skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas su dengs// ces brjod do// dgu pa smon lam btab pa ni/ na mo/ brgya bzhi'i mchod sbyin rgya chen po bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs su bsngo bar bgyi'o// sku gdung sātstsha btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis sems can thams cad dge ba bcu la spyod par gyur cig /mi dge ba bcu spangs par gyur cig /mar me brgya phul ba'i bsod nams kyis sems can thams cad ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas ye shes lnga'i don rtogs par gyur cig /gtor ma brgya phul ba'i bsod nams kyis sems can thams cad mu ge'i bskal pa las thar bar gyur cig /ngar glud brgya phul ba'i bsod nams kyis sems can thams cad bgegs kyi gnod pa'i lan chags dang bu lon thams cad byang bar gyur cig /mdo sde zab mo bton pa'i byin rlabs kyis sems can thams cad rtag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyur cig /brgya bzhi phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i lan chags bu lon thams cad 'khor bar gyur cig /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig /ces smon lam btab bo// bcu pa bzlog pa bya ba ni/ kyai/ mchod sbyin brgya bzhi'i bden stobs kyis// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// yas kyi bdud g.yos brgya bzhis zlog /mas kyi sri langs brgya bzhis zlog /pha bu'i rgan sri brgya bzhis zlog /ma bu'i byur sri brgya bzhis zlog

/byis pa'i chung sri brgya bzhis zlog /chos zor bon zor brgya bzhis zlog /gtad khram byad stems brgya bzhis zlog /lo skag zla skag brgya bzhis zlog /zhag skag za skag ngan pa brgya bzhis zlog /gza' skar ngan pa thams cad brgya bzhis zlog /rbad 'dre rbod gtong brgya bzhis zlog /mi yi shi kha brgya bzhis zlog /nor phyugs god kha brgya bzhis zlog /dgra kha rkun kha brgya bzhis zlog /skye bo'i yas kha ngan pa brgya bzhis zlog /sde brgyad 'byung po'i gnod pa brgya bzhis zlog /gnam gyi 'ju thag chad pa brgya bzhis zlog /sa yi rten phur phyungs pa brgya bzhis zlog /rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa brgya bzhis zlog /rgya yi gtsug lag ngan pa brgya bzhis zlog /bod kyi mo rtsis ngan pa brgya bzhis zlog /ngan dgu rtsub bcu thams cad brgya bzhis zlog /chags che nyam nga thams cad brgya bzhis zlog /ces brjod cing thal rdeb bya'o// de nas bdud bzhi gzugs brnyan dang glud sogs yas rdzas rnams gnas khang gi sgo dang nye bar dpag la/ hūm̐/ nyon cig ma lus bgegs kyi tshogs// lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs pa// 'byung po mkha' 'gro thams cad la// glud dang gtor ma 'di 'bul lo// de ring yon bdag 'khor bcas la// gnod par byed pa gang yang rung*// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di longs la// bzung ba las ni thar bar mdzod// bcings pa las ni grol bar mdzod// rin dang glud du gtor ma longs// bdag gis de ring khyod mchod do// song zhig bgegs chen 'gro bar gyis// phyin chad de ltar ma byed cig /khyod kyi stobs dang rtsal mthong na// khyod kyis bgegs chen mi nus min// khyod ni lha yi sprul pa ste// sngon chad mchod sbyin ma thob bar// de ring bdag gis khyod mchod kyis// me tog phreng ba spos dang dri// mar me zhal zas 'di rnams kyis// bgegs kyi rgyal po 'gro bar gyis// sngon gyi lan chags yod na yang*// mchod sbyin 'di yis 'bral bar mdzod// dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' dang ni// dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa yis// gnod par gyur na ma legs kyis// bgegs chen khyod ni da song zhig

/rdo rje chen po mchog 'dzin pa// bka' las gang du 'da' ba ni// rdo rje 'dzin pas myur du spangs// spangs pas sems can chen po ste// ji srid 'khor ba'i spyod yul du// ngan song gsum por ltung nas kyang*// shin tu mi bzod cho nges 'debs// bdag nyid chen pau sangs rgyas bka'// tshig las 'das na rdul du brlag /de bas bgegs chen khyod song la// dam tshig las ni ma 'da' zhig /ces brjod/ bcu gnyis pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ de nas yas rnams nad pa dang yon bdag la lan gsum bskor la/ des nad gdon dang chag che nyam nga thams cad blangs shing rang gnas su song bar bsam la/ spos dang gser skyems kyis sna drangs te/ phyogs ngan gang du btang ba'i sar khyer bar bya'o/ hūm̐/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bdud chen bzhi// bden pa chen po'i bka' la nyon// lha bdud bya ba'i dkar po khyod// ci yang med pa'i gnas su dengs// 'chi bdag bdud ni nag po khyod// nam mkha' mtha' yas gnas su dengs// nyon mongs bdud ni dmar po khyod// rnam shes mtha' yas gnas su dengs// phung po'i bdud ni ser po khyod// yod min med min gnas su dengs// sgrib pa rnam bzhi las byung ba'i// bdud kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas// 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig /skye mched rigs bzhi'i gnas su dengs// sa ma ya pra be sha ya dza dzaḥ zhes pas yas rnams dor/ shes rab snying po 'don cing gzungs sngags brjod// srung ba'i rab tu gnas shing 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab/ nang du log nas mdo 'don pa dang de'i snying po gro ga'am shog bur bris pa'i gzungs zhugs su bcug pa'i sātstsha bcu gnas khang gi phyogs mtshams bcu la so sor srung ba'i don du gzhug go /rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'i me tog 'thor zhing brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod bya'o// bcu gsum pa slar yang mtha' rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa bzang du bshams shing phul la/

na mo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas// lha bu'i bdud kyi g.yul ngo las// da ni rgyal lo rnam par rgyal// nyon mongs bdud kyi g.yul ngo las// da ni rgyal lo rnam par rgyal// phung po'i bdud kyi g.yul ngo las// da ni rgyal lo rnam par rgyal// 'chi bdag bdud kyi g.yul ngo las// da ni rgyal lo rnam par rgyal// zhes brjod cing las kyi rjes bsdu ba dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rgya cher brjod cing me tog char dbab pa sogs kyis bde legs su khyab par bya'o// gsum pa lo rgyus kyi sgo nas phan yon bstan pa ni/ sngon lha'i dbang po brgya byin bsnyun gyis zin pa la/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud bzhis zin par mkhyen nas brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'di mdzad pas/ brgya byin snyun las thar nas bde ba la bkod/ de ltar phan yon chen po dang ldan pa'i cho ga rdzas las brgya bzhir mtshan du grags pa de nyid 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi phyag tu babs pas/ rdo rje gdan gyi ka gdan spre'u 'dra ba la gter du sbas pa paṇḍi ta lnga brgyas bton nas gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che la bstsal/ des bod du bsnams nas gzhan phan phrin las rgya cher mdzad pa'o// cho ga de la'ang mdo lugs dang sngags lugs zhes tha dad du yod pa las/ 'di nyid mdo ltar du grags pa'i lugs so/ gzhan sngags lugs gshin rje nag po'i rgyud las btus pa/ rdo rje gdan nas bton te o rgyan chen po sogs las brgyud par grags pa'i yi ge zur pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyis phyag len du mdzad pa zhig snang ba ni/ yi ge rnying pa na gsal bar 'dug pa las shes so// de lta bu'i cho ga 'dis ban bon gyi phur kha zug pa dang*/ gtad chud pa dang*/ dgra rkun mang ba dang*/ skye bo'i ya ga ngan pa dang*/ mi'i shi kha bye ba dang*/ phyugs nad god kha byung ba dang*/

yul du nad rims dar ba dang*/ khyad par rgyal 'gong dang yi dwags zhugs pa dang*/ gza' skar ngan pa la shi ba dang*/ lus srog dbang thang rgud pa dang*/ rlung rta la dgra dar ba dang*/ keg chags che ba dang*/ sri'u dang nad pa cis kyang ma gsos pa sogs mdor na mi mthun pa'i 'gal rkyen sel ba sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa yin no// deng sang brgya bzhi'i cho ga shin tu dar ba ltar snang yang*/ 'ga' zhig 'chi bslu dang ma mo'i glud chog sogs kyang sbyar ba'i ngag 'don mang tsam snying por bya ba dang*/ la las tshigs bcad sor sdeb nyung ngu tsam la bsdus pa sogs/ yig rnying lhad med rang sor gnas pa shin tu dkon pas khungs thub kyi yid brtan dka' bar gyur na'ang*/ yig rnying gi sgrom gzhung sdebs pa na/ bar skabs so sor dbri bsnan gyi dri ma ngos zin pa ltar snang ba rnams dag par byas te/ bklag chog tu bkod pa yang*/ deng dus 'di tsam khungs ldan du rlom pa yin no// de ltar brgya bzhi'i cho ga 'dod don lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang*/ cho ga 'di'i lag len du byed pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa dang*/ dge sbyor 'tsho byed gzhan phan mchog sbyin gyis bskul bas kyang rkyen byas te snyoms las pa 'gyur med rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/// /
